name: Malaysian Borneo
about: The northeast monsoon (Nov–Feb) brings rougher seas and reduced diving visibility around Sipadan and Mabul; rainforest trekking and wildlife-watching continue largely unaffected year-round.
overview: Orangutans at Sepilok, pygmy elephants and proboscis monkeys along the Kinabatangan River, the summit trek up Mount Kinabalu, and Sipadan — regularly ranked among the world's best dive sites.
costOverview: Borneo is one of Southeast Asia's better values — a full local meal costs just a couple of dollars, and even the marquee orangutan and river wildlife tours stay reasonable next to African safari pricing.
